title: Alert friction and dashboard tiling field notes
summary: Field notes from a rapid investigation into alert fatigue and dashboard layout inefficiencies observed during Q3 rollouts. Contains proposed metric definitions, trace sampling heuristics, suggestions for tiling dashboards to reduce operator cognitive load, and experiments to reduce false positives tied to cold cache and tenant bursts.
objectives: 1) Reduce alert noise by 30% for inference latency and error alerts without masking real regressions. 2) Rework dashboard tiling so operators can find root cause in one glance. 3) Standardize span annotations and session keys used for multi-hop inference debugging.
metric_definitions:
Operator-first list of candidate metrics and pragmatic contracts. Each line is a short metric contract: name | unit | aggregation | cardinality guidance | alert rationale.

operator_time_to_first_token_ms | ms | p50/p95/p99 | low-cardinality (global + model) | SLO anchor for user-perceived latency.
kvcache_warmth_ratio | ratio (0-1) | avg over 5m | per-tenant, per-model | indicates cold-cache regressions; suppress alerts for < 1% of calls.
prefetch_hit_rate | ratio | avg over 1m | per-model | important for batched workflows; correlate with throughput deltas.
request_tail_token_latency_ms | ms | p99.9 over 1m | per-tenant | captures pathological token-slow paths; high signal for billing anomalies.
model_variant_fallback_rate | count(rate) | rate/min | per-region, per-model | sudden spike indicates routing/capacity fallback; pair with capacity alarms.
api_e2e_error_rate | percent | sum(errors)/sum(requests) over 5m | per-route, per-tenant | primary customer-facing error SLO.
embed_queue_time_ms | ms | p90 | per-queue-type | helpful for dedicated capacity tuning.
cache_eviction_pressure | count | delta over 5m | global | high values mean eviction storms affecting latency.
